title: AFP backs Teodoro’s move to suspend military ties with China

blocks.text: MANILA — The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) has backed the decision of Department of National Defense (DND) Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. to suspend military-to-military communications with China, accusing Beijing of using the engagement as a “smokescreen” to maintain its illegal presence in Philippine maritime territory. “First and foremost let me state that the AFP stands solidly behind and firmly supports the statement or the action of the SND (Secretary of National Defense) and to suspend direct communication channels with the People’s Republic of China.
